original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 4.3. Isothermal: To measure the binding isotherms for the binding of ERRγ with GSK5182 and 19 compound ITC experiments were performed using a MicroCal 200 isothermal titration microcalorimeter (MicroCal, Northampton, MA). We followed procedure as previously described (Biochemistry. 2010 Nov 30; 49(47):10216–27.). The sample cell of the calorimeter was loaded with 0.1375 mM ERRγ (LBD) in buffer A (20 mM Tris pH 7.5, 100 mM NaCl, 30% DMSO). The syringe was loaded with compound 19 (1 mM) in the same buffer A. Samples were injected at 2 min intervals to ensure that the titration curves had returned to baseline before the next injection. The data were fit using a one-site binding model available in the Origin software version 7.0.
original_paragraph.Figure 7 caption: Fig. 7. Binding analysis of GSK5182 and 19 with ligand-binding domain of ERRγ using isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC). Raw data from ITC (upper panel) and enthalpy changes per mole plotted as a function of the molar ratio of ERRγ (LBD) to GSK5182 and 19 (lower panel). GSK5182 and 19 were injected into a 250 μl cell containing ERRγ (LBD) at 30 °C. See text for details. The solid line represents the best fit curve.
